reviewFlows.instructions: Launch the app and browse Home, U.S., Immigration and Legal Updates without signing in.
Open My, tap Sign in, then enter the review identifier and password supplied in the store console.
Open Community to create a post or comment, or open a news article to comment, reply, like and report.
Save an article, then open My > Favorites or My > Reading history to verify cloud synchronization.
Open My > Push notifications and explicitly enable this device. The system permission prompt is never shown on first launch.
Open My > Account and privacy > Delete account. The final destructive action requires typing DELETE and permanently removes the signed-in account.

storeConsoleFields.apple: App Review Information > Sign-in information and Notes
